summary: Suppress near-duplicate alerts on POST /api/alerts within a configurable time window, returning the existing alert instead of creating a new row.

acceptance_criteria.text: On POST /api/alerts, when an active alert with the same Title (case-insensitive) and same Severity was created within the last N minutes (configurable window), no new alert row is created.
A suppressed request returns 200 OK with the existing matching alert as the body and response header 'X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true'.
A genuinely new (non-duplicate) alert still returns 201 Created with the created alert, and no suppression header set to true.
The suppression window in minutes is read from appsettings.json configuration and is not hardcoded.
Alerts with the same Title but a different Severity are not suppressed (a new alert is created).
A prior matching alert that is inactive does not cause suppression (a new alert is created).

adjacent_dependencies: AlertService.API/Services/IAlertService.cs (CreateAsync return shape changes to convey suppression)
New options type for the suppression window (e.g. AlertService.API/Configuration/*.cs) (new)
New service result type conveying Created vs Suppressed + AlertResponse (new)
constraints: Do not change public GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE behavior; only POST /api/alerts create path is affected.
Service layer must not reference HttpContext; controller owns the 200-vs-201 status and the X-Duplicate-Suppressed header.
Suppression window must be bound from configuration with a safe default; never hardcode the 15-minute value in code.
Duplicate match semantics: existing alert IsActive == true AND same Severity AND Title equal case-insensitively AND CreatedDate within window measured from TimeProvider UTC now.
Use the injected TimeProvider for the window boundary; do not call DateTime.UtcNow directly.
Follow existing result-object pattern (see AddTagsResult) rather than throwing to signal suppression.
DECIDED (human-confirmed 2026-10-06): config key 'AlertSuppression:WindowMinutes', default 15; a value <= 0 disables suppression.
DECIDED (human-confirmed 2026-10-06): when multiple active matches exist within the window, return the most recently created matching alert.
DECIDED (human-confirmed 2026-10-06): the incoming request's IsActive is ignored for matching; only the EXISTING alert's IsActive governs suppression (AC6).
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage of all six acceptance criteria: suppressed path (200 + header, no new row), created path (201), different-severity not suppressed, inactive-prior not suppressed, and window boundary (inside vs outside window).
